messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on route /v1/generate (model=redwood-llama-70b-int8, precision=INT8, deployment=d-prod-eu). p95 and p99 breached SLO. Auto-escalating to on-call.

oncall_alex: Got it, I'm on it. Paging SRE. What are the current numbers?

sre_jamie: p95 ~ 320ms (normal ~120ms), p99 ~ 2.1s (SLO p99 < 1s). Streaming stalls reported — a bunch of open connections waiting on fill tokens.

eng_maya: This started ~20m after the quantization calibration job (int8 profile) rolled to 60% traffic. Calibration-job id: calib-20260315-17. Could be KV cache mismatch or dequant path.

eng-ryan: Adding logs from nodes:
```
[2026-03-15T17:03:12Z] WARN kv_cache: miss_rate=0.42, avg_kv_latency=120us
[2026-03-15T17:03:14Z] WARN dequant: slow-path=true, per_token_ms=15
[2026-03-15T17:03:18Z] ERROR stream: stall_detected session=abc123 waiting_for_tokens>500ms
```

cs_ana: We just heard from a customer (Acme) — voice transcription stalled during long call, they saw repeated timeouts. CS ticket 89231 opened. Customer impact: partial failures for streaming flows.

prod_tom: Can we mitigate by routing long streaming sessions to fallback (fp16 or previous int8 profile)? Need quick fix to stop customer-visible errors.

eng_maya: Agreed. Proposing two immediate mitigations: 1) rollback new int8 calibration rollout to previous stable profile, 2) add routing rule to route streaming requests with context>4096 tokens to fp16 variant. Both are low-risk.

oncall_alex: Which one is faster? I can trigger rollback now. If rollback takes too long, we do routing rule.

eng-ryan: Rollback command (will revert calib-20260315-17 to calib-20260308-stable):
```
redwoodctl rollout revert --deployment d-prod-eu --profile calib-20260315-17 --to calib-20260308-stable --force --reason "p99 spike"
```
ETA ~5m to start serving.

infra_bot: Deploy job queued: job-id=deploy-3165551248. Estimated start 30s.

oncall_alex: Kicking rollback now. eng_maya you have the keys for the canary scope?

eng_maya: I do. Running.

eng_maya: rollback started — monitoring p95/p99.

eng-ryan: In parallel adding temporary routing lambda:
```
redwoodctl routes add --name streaming-long-fallback --match "context_tokens>4096 && route==/v1/stream" --target model=redwood-llama-70b-fp16 --priority 100
```
Should be instant once applied.

sre_jamie: Watching dashboards. Correlating with KV cache shard logs. If rollback doesn't help we may need to flush KV cache on affected nodes.

(2 min later)

eng_maya: rollback completed on canary, increasing rollout to 100%.

infra_bot: Rollback finished for d-prod-eu at 2026-03-15T17:05:04Z.

sre_jamie: Metrics coming down: p95 now 150ms, p99 920ms and trending down. Streaming stalls decreased.

cs_ana: Notifying Acme that we rolled back the calibration and are monitoring. Ticket 89231 updated. :thumbsup:

prod_tom: Good. Root cause hypothesis: calibration introduced a dequant slow-path for certain attention patterns with long KV lifetimes; plus continuous batching exposed a path that increased per-token latency for streaming. Need postmortem.

eng-ryan: I captured traces for 47 affected requests: trace ids attached to incident log. Key stack shows `dequant_slow_path` calls with abnormal memory copy patterns.

sre_jamie: Action items:
- ENG: create follow-up PR to add guard in calibration to avoid enabling on long-context routes (owner eng_maya).
- INFRA: add automated KV cache inspect on calibration rollouts (owner eng-ryan).
- SRE: run job to flush KV cache for older nodes and add alert for stream stalls (owner sre_jamie).
- CS/Prod: communicate with impacted customers (owner cs_ana, prod_tom).

eng_maya: I'll take the ENG item. Quick note: avoid blanket 100% rollouts of new lightweight quant profiles for 7-day window after calibration until we have added extra regression tests.

oncall_alex: Handoff: I'm on-call for 30m more, will remain as incident lead until 17:35Z. After that @sre_jamie will take over.

sre_jamie: I'll take the handoff at 17:35Z. Leaving this open until p99 holds <900ms for 15m and CS confirms no further customer errors.

prod_tom: Filing an incident ticket and scheduling follow-up postmortem meeting. Proposed time: 2026-03-16 10:00Z. Invite ENG, SRE, INFRA, CS.

eng-ryan: For the postmortem I'll attach the calibration telemetry and a diff of kernel selection for int8 vs fp16 for impacted models.

cs_ana: Acme acknowledged the rollback and said they saw immediate improvement. They asked for a short RCA once ready.

oncall_alex: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread for live notes. If anything regresses ping @channel. :white_check_mark:
